en.title: More ways to inspect a connection
highlights: Seven more network tools: TCP ports, HTTP details, rule prediction, configuration diff, traffic breakdown, core runtime and node details. DNS supports record types.
CLI queries stay read-only; node selection is interactive, and terminal updates restore the backend and service state.
TUI has dedicated Settings and Actions pages, with the same validation and authorization as CLI.
en.known: Rule prediction marks dynamic conditions as unknown. System probes depend on platform support and are restricted during Claude protection.
en.summary: Eighteen network tools, plus clearer CLI and TUI management.

zh.title: 连接细节，看得更清楚
highlights: 新增 TCP 端口、HTTP 详情、规则预判、配置差异、流量分解、内核运行与节点详情七项工具；DNS 可选记录类型。
CLI 查询保持只读，支持交互选节点，终端更新后恢复后台和服务状态。
TUI 提供独立的设置与操作页，沿用 CLI 校验与系统授权。
zh.known: 规则预判对动态条件返回未知；系统探针依赖平台能力，Claude 保护期间受限。
zh.summary: 十八项网络工具，CLI 与 TUI 管理入口更完整。

en.title: Network toolbox
highlights: Ten new checks join the website check: DNS comparison, connection timing, IPv4/IPv6, rule and exit, TLS, stability, UDP, ping, route trace and capped download.
The same tools on desktop, phone and tablet, with cancel, adjustable options and export. No history is kept.
The terminal interface and cor network offer the same tools.
Fixed: pages could not be switched in the terminal interface after cancelling quickly.
en.known: Ping and route trace depend on what the system provides, and are unavailable during Claude protection.
en.summary: Eleven network checks, from DNS and timing to the route a request takes.

zh.title: 网络工具箱
highlights: 网络诊断新增十项工具：DNS 对照、连接耗时、IPv4/IPv6、规则与出口、TLS、稳定性、UDP、Ping、路由追踪、限量下载。
桌面、手机、平板共用同一套工具，可取消、可调参数、可导出，不留历史。
终端界面与 cor network 同步提供。
修复终端界面快速取消后无法切页的问题。
zh.known: Ping 与路由追踪依赖系统能力，Claude 保护期间不可用。
zh.summary: 十一项网络检查，从解析、耗时到出口，逐步排查。

en.title: Update recovery, lighter installers
highlights: A failed Windows update now says why, and can be retried once the cause is cleared.
Downloads recover better from drops and sustained low speed. TUN start-up on macOS is checked for readiness.
Claude protection covers more of the official inbound addresses.
The desktop node list uses less memory, and installers are smaller again.

zh.title: 更新更稳，安装包更小
highlights: Windows 更新失败时给出具体原因，排除后可直接重试。
下载断连或持续低速时恢复更稳；完善 macOS 上 TUN 的启动就绪检查。
Claude 保护补充覆盖官方入站地址。
桌面节点列表占用内存更少，安装包进一步缩小。

en.title: Protection and per-app fixes
highlights: Fixed a brief false TUN-bypass warning as Claude protection starts, and a core that would not start again after quitting with protection on.
Android per-app routing no longer mistakes nodes with emoji in their names for missing ones, and respects your UDP switch again.
If rebuilding the VPN fails after repeated per-app changes, the existing connection is kept.
Smaller installers.

zh.title: 保护与分流修复
highlights: 修复 Claude 保护开启瞬间误报 TUN 绕行，以及带着保护退出后内核无法再次启动的问题。
Android 应用分流不再把名称含 Emoji 的节点误判为失效，并重新遵守 UDP 开关。
连续修改应用分流时，VPN 重建失败会保留原有连接。
安装包体积更小。

en.title: Per-app exits on Android, a steadier Linux
highlights: Android per-app routing gains named rule groups, app search, and a chosen exit for each app: a node, a policy group, direct or reject. Choosing an exit needs Android 10 or later.
On Linux, the core starts on networks without IPv6, the old autostart entry no longer opens a window, and fast window resizing no longer stretches the picture.
Clearer errors and fallbacks for node tests, updates and Geo downloads.
During Claude protection, appearance settings and read-only pages stay usable while network changes remain locked.
en.known: Intermittent TLS failures and slow long-lived downloads are still being investigated.
en.summary: Refined app routing, updates, and everyday connection management.

zh.title: 应用可指定出口，Linux 更稳
highlights: Android 应用分流支持命名规则组、搜索应用，并可为应用指定节点、策略组、直连或拦截；指定出口需 Android 10 及以上。
Linux：无 IPv6 的网络下内核正常启动，旧自启动入口不再弹出窗口，快速缩放窗口不再拉伸画面。
节点测速、更新与 Geo 下载的报错和回退更清晰。
Claude 保护期间，外观设置与只读操作照常可用，网络修改继续锁定。
zh.known: 间歇性 TLS 失败与部分长连接下载慢速仍在排查。
zh.summary: 日常连接更稳，应用分流与更新体验进一步完善。

en.title: A refreshed interface
highlights: Refreshed interfaces on desktop, phone and tablet: a collapsible sidebar, grid or list views for proxies and subscriptions, and one consistent rule list.
Android per-app routing rebuilt around three modes: all apps, only selected, or exclude selected, with icons, search and reconnect on save.
Subscription, Geo and client updates try a separate direct route when the proxy is down, and keep the existing configuration if they fail.
Errors are shown by severity, with shortcuts to export diagnostics and open an issue.

zh.title: 界面焕新
highlights: 桌面、手机与平板界面更新：侧栏可折叠，代理与订阅可在宫格、列表间切换，规则列表样式统一。
重做 Android 应用分流：全部应用、仅选中、排除选中三种模式，支持图标、搜索和保存后重连。
订阅、Geo 与客户端更新在代理不可用时尝试独立直连，失败则保留原有配置。
错误按影响程度展示，并提供导出诊断与新建 Issue 的入口。
